aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: Both primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The config_to_repo_refs dependency is the clearest async signal because downstream repo/refs behavior can continue under a stale assumption about config exception semantics.
The pack_to_object_store dependency is retained as a shared API-contract probe for semantic integration beyond textual merge conflicts.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts and implicated files, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: StackedConfig.default_backends() must ignore missing or inaccessible default config files, allowing Repo.init() and symbolic HEAD updates to proceed under HOME=/nonexistent.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when both the config default-backend probe and the repo/refs symbolic HEAD probe pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The repo/refs agent may assume global config lookup can raise filesystem permission errors or may locally mask the exception in repo.py, leaving the producer config contract inconsistent with other consumers.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Object-store add_pack behavior depends on the pack layer's object lookup, iteration, checksum, and raw object semantics.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when pack lookup and object-store add_pack probes both pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The object-store agent may implement add_pack around a stale pack iteration or raw-object assumption, producing a clean merge that fails once the final pack layer is integrated.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact visible in the integrated history.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves Dulwich's config/repo/refs and pack/object-store contracts promptly.
